manifesto.p1_text: Heritage is not a static museum, but a living resonance. We bridge civic duty with eternal essence.
manifesto.p2_text: Every seeker is their own light. We provide mentorship and tools; the path is yours.
manifesto.p3_text: AI and ancient manuscripts are partners in the grand alchemy of memory. We use modern tools to unlock archaic whispers.

welcome.message: We are honored to have you here. Vikshu is a sacred space dedicated to preserving global heritage and fostering collective enlightenment. May your journey with us be one of wisdom and inner discovery.

about.subtitle: Our Vision
about.title: About Us
about.philosophy: Vikshu Foundation stands at the intersection of ancient wisdom and modern innovation, where heritage is not merely preserved but lived, breathed, and evolved.
about.mission_1_text: We safeguard the spiritual and cultural legacies that form humanity's collective conscience, ensuring they remain vibrant for generations to come.
about.mission_2_text: We unite seekers, scholars, and stewards from across the world, creating a living network of wisdom-keepers committed to collective enlightenment.
about.mission_3_text: We don't just study heritage—we activate it. Through education, restoration, and innovation, we transform ancient wisdom into solutions for modern challenges.
about.closing: Under the guidance of visionary leadership, Vikshu Foundation continues to expand its reach while staying rooted in the timeless principles of truth, service, and inner awakening.
